findings.reason: CC0 reference metadata is admitted, but marketQuotes=false and scoringPriceInput=false.
Official Kraken API guidance requires prior permission for non-personal commercial use of publicly accessible market data.
findings.requiredNextStep: Written market-data permission covering commercial derived scoring/display, retention/replay and the intended web/mobile use.

findings.reason: Existing BYOK path is limited to authenticated user-private account data and explicitly forbids public display, redistribution, shared cache and JetStream publication.

Official World Bank catalog identifies the commodity dataset as public CC-BY-4.0 and commercially reusable with attribution; it does not provide crypto spot-price coverage and therefore cannot unlock /api/crypto/score.
findings.requiredNextStep: Separate commodity adapter, immutable source/version evidence and instrument manifest before capability admission.

findings.reason: Commercial reuse is claimed with attribution, but the published collection workflow pulls mutable opaque Docker images and the dataset scope is on-chain/derivatives metrics rather than a provenance-complete spot-price feed. It therefore does not satisfy software provenance/packaging plus scoringPriceInput gates.
findings.possibleUse: Supplemental research/scoring features after provenance review; not current price authority.

findings.reason: Commercially reusable on-chain holder/risk dataset may be useful as a future scoring feature, but it does not provide the live price input required to unlock score display.

enforcement.nextAdmissionRequirement: At least one source must independently PASS scoringPriceInput plus all required commercial display, derivation, cache, JetStream, replay, retention, backup and audit-evidence gates.
